resources.string: The keyboard\'s file manager as a tool: browse by folder or by kind, preview files, send them into the chat you are typing in, zip, rename, copy, move and delete, one list or two side by side, on the phone and in folders you add, such as a USB drive or a network share
Two lists side by side
Copy and Move go straight from one list to the other
Shows two lists of files side by side. Copy and Move then go straight from one list to the other. This setting is off by default.
Show files as a grid
Thumbnails in rows of four; off shows a list with names and sizes
Shows files and folders as a grid of thumbnails. Turn it off for a list with each name, size and date. The view button in the panel\'s header switches it too. This setting is on by default.
Tap a file to preview it
Opens the file in the keyboard rather than in its app

A tap on a file shows it in the keyboard: a picture, a video, a PDF, text, an app package or what a zip holds. Open with is a button there. Off, a tap opens the file in the app for it. This setting is on by default.
Thumbnails
Pictures and videos show themselves rather than an icon
Shows a small picture of each photo and video. Off, every file shows an icon for its kind, which is quicker on a slow drive or network share. This setting is on by default.
Folders first
Folders come before files whatever the sort
Lists folders above files. Off, folders sort among the files by name, date or size. This setting is on by default.
Show hidden files
Files and folders whose names start with a dot
Lists files and folders whose names start with a dot, which apps use for their own settings and caches. The panel\'s ⋮ menu switches it too. This setting is off by default.
Servers and clouds
Your own servers and cloud accounts, under Places in the Files tool
Servers and clouds

The Files tool lists these under Places, where you can open, add, rename and move files on them. They share one list with the locations on Backup: a location you set up for backups shows here, and one that you add here gets automatic backups only if you tick it on Automatic backup. Nothing goes to a WM Keyboard server.
Add a server or cloud
Your own server, a NAS, a bucket or a cloud account
Where are the files?
The app forgets how to sign in to it and stops using it, for files and for backups. Nothing on the server is deleted.
Automatic backups go here too
Files only, no automatic backups
